req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-019 requires GET /openapi.json to return an HTTP 2xx response with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path verifying exact status code 200 and top-level OpenAPI fields; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) must return 4xx, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA — Content-Type header must be exactly 'application/json' and the 'openapi' version string must start with '3.'; (4) DT — verifying key structural fields (info.title, info.version, paths) exist with exact expected values from the FastAPI app configuration; (5) EP — verifying the paths object contains the known task endpoints.

tests.name: test_openapi_json_positive_status_and_structure
expected: Top-level 'openapi' key exists and starts with '3.'
trace: R-TASK-019: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_positive_status_and_structure():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")
    assert "info" in body
    assert "paths" in body

test_openapi_json_positive_status_and_structure()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_boundary_content_type_and_openapi_version
expected: 'openapi' field value starts with exactly '3.' (not '2.' or '4.')
trace: R-TASK-019: expected payload must be OpenAPI 3.x JSON
BVA on version prefix boundary: '3.' vs '2.' vs '4.'
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_boundary_content_type_and_openapi_version():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    openapi_ver = body["openapi"]
    assert openapi_ver.startswith("3."), f"Expected 3.x, got {openapi_ver}"
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("2."), f"Must not be 2.x, got {openapi_ver}"
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("4."), f"Must not be 4.x, got {openapi_ver}"

test_openapi_json_boundary_content_type_and_openapi_version()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_paths_contain_task_endpoints():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    paths = body["paths"]
    assert "/tasks/" in paths
    assert "/tasks/{task_id}" in paths
    assert "/" in paths

test_openapi_json_paths_contain_task_endpoints()
